title: Speak Readings dot dot dot
body:
xDrip April 24, 2021


### Expected behavior
Speak readings should clearly pronounce the blood glucose reading.


### Actual behavior
The test will result in the voice saying dot dot dot instead of the blood glucose value.


### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to  Settings -> Speak Readings
2. Enable "Speak Readings" and "Speak Alerts" and "Speak everything twice".
3. Go to an alarm page and test it

Disabling "Speak everything twice" solves the problem.

But, what if someone wants to enable it?
